notes:
Statistics retained as printed. Original and replication tests extracted independently. No metric conversion. Original uses one-tailed directional tests. Replication presents audiovisual stimuli; source tables label outcome lists but methods and scoring concern item/order recall.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly contrast the present failure to find improved performance at a slow rate with the original presentation-rate effect.
Completion source review (n_o): Explicit experiment-specific 24 participants, full design allocation and participant-level ANOVA establish the model sample; not a whole-paper recruitment count and not inferred from df. No arithmetic-derived N.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Named main effect and experiment/outcome match the supplied locator; requested test statistic is printed as F. No conversion.
Completion source review (pval_value_o): Printed p < .001 belongs to the same named main-effect F test; bound and printed precision preserved.
